doc.name: B — editorial frames, linen summer morning (dawn), quiet documentary realism

config.text:
EDITORIAL BRIEF — edit before running.
Series setting: linen summer morning (dawn)
Register: quiet documentary realism
Cast: one female lead and one male lead, same two people in every frame
Wardrobe: [describe once — it must not change between frames]
Frames: 6
Usage: [editorial / campaign / lookbook]
STAGE 1 — casting references in, continuity director locks the look, then one writer per frame.
STAGE 2 — each frame renders independently with the same cast references attached.

config.system_prompt:
You are the continuity director for an editorial series set in a linen summer morning (dawn), shot in a register of quiet documentary realism.

From the attached cast references, write ONE locked description block covering both leads: face, hair, build, skin, wardrobe piece by piece, footwear and any jewellery. Fix the location, the time of day, the weather and the grade.

This block is restated verbatim by every downstream frame writer, so it must be complete, concrete and free of anything that could change between frames. Grade target: high-contrast teal-and-orange with protected mid-tone skin.

Return the block only — no headings, no commentary.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a linen summer morning (dawn), shot in a register of quiet documentary realism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a tight profile frame with the second lead soft in the background, featuring one lead sharp, one soft.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 180mm long macro at f/2, using a shallow out-of-focus foreground element occluding the lower third, at a wide shot.

LIGHT. Led tube accents in two contrasting hues placed in depth. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a neutral commercial grade with clean whites and no colour cast.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a linen summer morning (dawn), shot in a register of quiet documentary realism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a mirror or reflection frame carrying both leads, featuring both leads via a reflective surface.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 135mm telephoto at f/1.4, using deep negative space above the subject with a low horizon, at a low-angle hero frame.

LIGHT. Blue-hour ambient with a single warm practical for separation. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to warm amber highlights rolling into cool slate shadows.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a linen summer morning (dawn), shot in a register of quiet documentary realism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a two-shot of both leads sharing the frame, featuring both leads, medium two-shot.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 50mm anamorphic with 2x squeeze at f/16, using leading lines converging on the subject from the lower corners, at a cowboy three-quarter.

LIGHT. Paired strip-box rim lights raking both edges of the subject. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a filmic grade with halation on the specular highlights.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a linen summer morning (dawn), shot in a register of quiet documentary realism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a back-of-head frame of the female lead facing away into the scene, featuring the female lead from behind.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on an 8mm circular fisheye at f/2.8, using rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-right, at a cowboy three-quarter.

LIGHT. Blue-hour ambient with a single warm practical for separation. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a bleach-bypass look with crushed saturation and lifted contrast.

OUTPUT. Reply with a single continuous prompt paragraph. Never explain, never bullet, never wrap it in markdown fences.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a linen summer morning (dawn), shot in a register of quiet documentary realism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a low-angle frame of the male lead against the sky or ceiling, featuring the male lead from below.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 28mm at f/1.4, using a stacked layered composition with three depth planes, at a two-shot.

LIGHT. Scrim-diffused midday daylight, one stop under the ambient. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a sun-bleached grade with faded blacks and a green-yellow bias.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a solo portrait of the male lead, featuring the male lead alone, chest-up.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 50mm normal at f/4, using a shallow out-of-focus foreground element occluding the lower third, at a medium close-up.

LIGHT. Paired strip-box rim lights raking both edges of the subject. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a low-key grade holding detail in the deepest shadows only.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.
